title: Artifact
description: A made object canon treats as a character in its own right -- it has a power, and a cost for using it. Written after four folders were found to have no schema at all: the validator looked up a schema by folder name, got `None`, and moved on, so these were silently exempt for as long as they have existed.

material.description: What it is made of. A list because the interesting ones are composites.

risk.description: What it costs to use. Every artifact has one; that is the point of the category.

related_characters.description: `character_` ids. Resolved by the reference walker, not here.

canon.description: How firmly this is established. `primary` is stated by the source material, `inferred` is a reading canon has committed to.
